sources.title: Define a favicon to show in search results
Next.js sitemap file convention (images and videos)

findings.title: Image audit is one bundled check and cannot coach Google Images eligibility
findings.why_it_ranks: Google Images, Discover, and SERP thumbnails still use alt text, nearby captions, descriptive filenames, HTML , and page context. CSS background images are not indexed. Keyword-stuffed alt is treated as spam. Product copy sells 'Image optimisation insights' as Pro, but the only images-category check is img-alt.
findings.nextjs_how: Use next/image with a required descriptive alt (empty string only for decorative). Prefer real output (next/image does this). Put content images next to relevant copy and wrap in
findings.seoBoost_gap: lib/scanner.ts analysePage (lines 869-899) only counts missing alt (undefined) and, if alt is complete, warns on width/height when >50% of images lack dims. It never scores: empty vs meaningful alt, keyword stuffing, generic filenames, figcaption/title, <picture>/srcset fallback src, or CSS-only images. Empty alt="" passes as 'all have alt'. No howToFix for Next.js Image.
findings.verify_how: Scan a page with alt="" decorative, alt="seo seo seo", CSS background hero, and <figure><figcaption>. Expect separate checks (img-alt-quality, img-filename, img-caption) plus a pass for decorative empty alt. Confirm Google Images doc: HTML img src required.

findings.title: No image sitemap audit; SeoBoost sitemap.ts emits no image:image entries
findings.why_it_ranks: Google still recommends image sitemaps for images it may miss (especially JS-loaded next/image URLs). Only image:loc is required; caption/title/geo/license tags are deprecated. Next.js MetadataRoute.Sitemap supports images: string[].
findings.nextjs_how: In app/sitemap.ts add images: ['https://seoboost.app/opengraph-image'] (absolute, stable) on each URL that has indexable images. Next emits xmlns:image and <image:image><image:loc>. CDN hosts must be verified in Search Console. Do not robots-disallow /_next/image.
findings.seoBoost_gap: runDomainChecks (lib/scanner.ts ~1421-1448) only counts <loc> and lastmod. It never looks for image:image / image:loc. app/sitemap.ts lists page URLs only. Scanner also skips .xml/.png/.webp/.avif paths in PROGRAMMATIC_PATTERNS, so it cannot crawl a standalone image sitemap as a page.
findings.verify_how: Fetch /sitemap.xml and assert image namespace + image:loc. Add scanner check sitemap-images: warning when HTML has content but sitemap has zero image:image. Rich Results / GSC Sitemaps report.

findings.title: VideoObject check is presence-only and misses required fields
findings.why_it_ranks: In 2026 videos still appear in Web Search, Video mode, Google Images, Discover, plus Key Moments, LIVE badge, and moving previews. Required VideoObject: name, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate. Recommended: description, duration, contentUrl and/or embedUrl. Presence of @type VideoObject without those fields does not make a video eligible.
findings.nextjs_how: On each watch page export JSON-LD VideoObject (Script or generateMetadata-adjacent). thumbnailUrl must be a stable URL (not signed/expiring CDN). Prefer contentUrl to a fetchable MP4/WebM so Google can generate previews. For YouTube/Vimeo embeds set embedUrl to the iframe src. Dedicated watch page if video is the primary content.
findings.seoBoost_gap: lib/scanner.ts lines 1173-1195 count iframe[youtube|vimeo] or <video>, then pass if any JSON-LD mentions VideoObject. No parse of name/thumbnailUrl/uploadDate/contentUrl/embedUrl/duration. No watch-page vs complementary-video distinction. No thumbnail stability or poster= check. howToFix snippet uses uploadDate 2025-01-01 and omits embedUrl.
findings.verify_how: Scan a page with <video> plus incomplete VideoObject (name only). Expect warning listing missing required props. Validate a complete block in https://search.google.com/test/rich-results.

findings.title: OG/Twitter image audit ignores Google thumbnail metadata; SeoBoost OG assets are missing
findings.why_it_ranks: As of 2026-03-02 Google explicitly uses schema.org primaryImageOfPage / mainEntity image and og:image to pick SERP, Discover, and AI Overview thumbnails. Rules: relevant, not a logo, no heavy text, not extreme aspect ratio, high-res (Discover: >=1200px wide, ~16:9, >=300K). Twitter/X still needs twitter:card + twitter:image (summary_large_image ~1200x675).
findings.nextjs_how: Prefer app/opengraph-image.tsx and app/twitter-image.tsx with ImageResponse from next/og (export alt, size 1200x630, contentType). Or static opengraph-image.png + opengraph-image.alt.txt. Per-route generateMetadata images for glossary. Do not use the site logo as og:image. Keep og:image URL identical to primaryImageOfPage.
findings.seoBoost_gap: Scanner og-tags (901-934) only tests presence of og:title/description/image/type. No og:image:alt, no absolute HTTPS URL, no width/height, no 1200px floor, no logo-as-OG heuristic, no primaryImageOfPage. twitter-cards skips image if card=summary. Product: app/layout.tsx points to /opengraph-image.png, /twitter-image.png, /icon.png; public/ has only googlecfc4c7654c4c969a.html; no app/opengraph-image.* or app/twitter-image.*. Glossary generateMetadata openGraph has no images. Organization JSON-LD logo is icon.png, not a page image.
findings.verify_how: curl -I production /opengraph-image and /twitter-image (200, image/*, >=1200 wide). Facebook Sharing Debugger / X Card Validator. Scanner: fail relative og:image, logo-only OG, missing og:image:alt, and missing primaryImageOfPage when og:image exists.

findings.title: LCP / next/image coaching is pre-Next 16 and the marketing hero mis-prioritizes images
findings.why_it_ranks: LCP is a ranking Core Web Vital. Next.js 16 (this repo: next@16.1.6) deprecated Image priority in favor of preload. Docs: for a single LCP hero prefer loading="eager" or fetchPriority="high"; do not combine preload with loading or fetchPriority. sizes missing on fill/responsive images makes the browser assume 100vw and download a huge srcset candidate.
findings.nextjs_how: One LCP image per viewport: <Image src={hero} alt="…" width height sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 1200px" fetchPriority="high" />. Below-fold: default lazy. Remote src requires images.remotePatterns in next.config. next.config has neither remotePatterns nor formats.
findings.seoBoost_gap: lazy-loading check (789-815) only reads HTML loading=lazy and fetchpriority=high. It never detects next/image /_next/image URLs, missing sizes, deprecated priority, or preload. howToFix still says add priority. Product hero (app/hero-animations.tsx 206-215) marks four 32px Dicebear SVGs priority + fetchPriority=high + unoptimized — those cannot be LCP and steal bandwidth. No sizes prop.
findings.verify_how: Lighthouse/PSI LCP element on /. Expect not the 32px avatars. Scanner: if first large img has loading=lazy → critical; if >1 fetchpriority=high → warning; if srcset without sizes → warning. Next 16 snippets must not recommend priority.

findings.title: No AVIF/WebP or next/image formats coaching
findings.why_it_ranks: Google indexes AVIF, WebP, JPEG, PNG, GIF, SVG, BMP. Modern formats cut bytes and help LCP. Next.js Image Optimization negotiates via Accept; formats: ['image/avif','image/webp'] serves AVIF first. Default without config is typically WebP-only.
findings.nextjs_how: next.config.ts images.formats = ['image/avif','image/webp']. Keep a fallback (or next/image src) in a supported raster. AVIF encodes ~50% slower, ~20% smaller than WebP; cache both. Do not use data: URIs for large heroes.
findings.seoBoost_gap: Category comment says 'format hints' but no check inspects src/srcset type, Accept-negotiated /_next/image, or <picture> sources. Pricing still claims image optimisation insights.
findings.verify_how: Request an optimized image with Accept: image/avif and expect image/avif. Scanner: warning if all content images are unoptimized PNG/JPEG >200KB with no picture/webp/avif or /_next/image.

findings.title: No captions, transcripts, or Key Moments (Clip / SeekToAction) coaching
findings.why_it_ranks: Key Moments still ship in Search (Clip in all languages; SeekToAction in 12 languages). Google auto-detects chapters; publisher Clip/YouTube timestamps win. Captions/transcripts are a11y (WCAG 1.2.2) and give Google crawlable speech-to-text. Video previews need fetchable bytes + max-video-preview (layout already sets -1).
findings.nextjs_how: Native <video>: add <track kind="captions" srclang="en" src="/captions/en.vtt" default /> and a visible transcript. JSON-LD: nest Clip[] (name, startOffset, url?t=) or SeekToAction potentialAction target with {seek_to_second_number}. YouTube: timestamp lines in the description. Video must be >=30s and deep-linkable.
findings.seoBoost_gap: Zero checks for <track>, kind=captions/subtitles, transcript text, Clip, SeekToAction, or YouTube chapter timestamps. video-schema howToFix never mentions chapters. No coaching that nosnippet opts out of Key Moments.
findings.verify_how: If <video> or youtube iframe exists: warning when no <track> and no Clip/SeekToAction. Pass when VTT track or Clip hasPart is present. Rich Results Test Key Moments eligibility.

findings.title: No video sitemap detection; Next sitemap videos[] unused
findings.why_it_ranks: Google still recommends video sitemaps (or mRSS) for discovery, especially new or JS players. Required: thumbnail_loc, title, description, and content_loc or player_loc. Must match VideoObject. Not a substitute for schema. Skip unrelated complementary clips.
findings.nextjs_how: app/sitemap.ts videos: [{ title, thumbnail_loc, description, content_loc or player_loc }]. Next emits xmlns:video. Reference the same URLs as VideoObject.contentUrl/embedUrl/thumbnailUrl.
findings.seoBoost_gap: Domain sitemap check never looks for video:video / media:content. app/sitemap.ts has no videos array. Fine for SeoBoost today (no product video) but the auditor cannot coach customer video sites.
findings.verify_how: When crawled pages contain video and sitemap lacks video:video → warning with Next.js videos[] snippet. Do not fail sites with zero videos.

findings.title: Favicon / apple-touch audit does not match Google Search rules; product icons are broken
findings.why_it_ranks: Google can show one favicon per hostname in organic results. Requirements: square, >=8x8 (recommend >48x48), crawlable by Googlebot-Image, stable URL. Supported Search formats: BMP, GIF, ICO, PNG, JPEG, PPM, TIFF — not SVG. Apple wants 180x180 apple-touch-icon. Next file conventions: app/favicon.ico, app/icon.(png|svg), app/apple-icon.png.
findings.nextjs_how: Add app/favicon.ico plus app/icon.svg (browsers) and app/apple-icon.png 180x180. Or ImageResponse icon.tsx (32+) and apple-icon.tsx (180). Do not rely on metadata.icons pointing at a missing /icon.png. Manifest icons need real 192 and 512 PNGs, not one 32px file claimed as both.
findings.seoBoost_gap: favicon check (1295-1318) treats any .png/.svg or apple-touch-icon as 'Modern formats' good. It never checks 48x48+, 1:1 ratio, Googlebot crawlability, or that SVG-only fails Google Search favicon. Product: layout icons all /icon.png; manifest 32 and 512 both /icon.png; no app/icon.*, app/apple-icon.*, or public PNG/ICO/SVG.
findings.verify_how: Home page has <link rel="icon"> to a square PNG/ICO >=48px that 200s. GSC URL Inspection. Scanner: warning for SVG-only or <48px; warning if apple-touch-icon missing.

findings.title: remotePatterns missing; scanner cannot coach Next remote / unoptimized images
findings.why_it_ranks: Remote next/image URLs that are not in remotePatterns fail at runtime or force unoptimized, skipping AVIF/WebP, srcset, and width/height CLS protection. domains is deprecated since Next 14. Hero already loads https://api.dicebear.com with unoptimized.
findings.nextjs_how: next.config.ts images.remotePatterns: [{ protocol: 'https', hostname: 'api.dicebear.com', pathname: '/7.x/**' }] (or drop remote avatars). Never use images.domains. Keep unoptimized only for SVG/auth images the optimizer cannot process.
findings.seoBoost_gap: No check for /_next/image?url= vs raw third-party src, unoptimized, or missing remotePatterns. howToFix never mentions next.config images. remotePatterns also needed if the auditor later fetches customer OG images through this Next host.
findings.verify_how: Build without unoptimized remote Image: must error until remotePatterns set. Scanner: if img src is off-origin and not /_next/image → hint to add remotePatterns + sizes + width/height.

findings.title: CLS-from-images check is gated and incomplete
findings.why_it_ranks: CLS is a ranking Core Web Vital. Images without reserved aspect ratio shift the page. next/image prevents this when width+height or fill+positioned parent is set. CSS background heroes and fill without relative parent still shift.
findings.nextjs_how: Always set width and height, or fill with a relative/absolute/fixed parent and aspect-ratio / explicit height. placeholder="blur" on LCP is optional. Do not leave height auto without width.
findings.seoBoost_gap: Dimensions are only evaluated when every img has an alt attribute and missingDims >= 50% (887-892). A page with 1/4 missing dims and all alts present is marked good. No check for style aspect-ratio, fill without parent, or next/image-generated width/height attributes (which Next does emit — so Next sites may pass even when customers used fill poorly in source).
findings.verify_how: Split img-dimensions from img-alt. Warn if any content image lacks width&height and lacks CSS aspect-ratio. PSI CLS < 0.1.

findings.title: 2026 Google Images / video surfaces are not explained in coaching copy
findings.why_it_ranks: Surfaces that still matter on 2026-09-11: (1) Google Images including Product/Recipe/Video badges when image is a required schema field; (2) SERP text-result thumbnails; (3) Discover large images; (4) AI Overview / Search thumbnails via primaryImageOfPage + og:image; (5) Video mode, web video results, Key Moments, LIVE badge, video previews; (6) hostname favicon in organic results. CSS images still do not index. max-image-preview:large is required for large Discover/SERP images.
findings.nextjs_how: Keep robots.googleBot max-image-preview: 'large' and max-video-preview: -1 (already in app/layout.tsx). Add WebPage.primaryImageOfPage pointing at the same absolute URL as og:image (not the logo). For Image-badge types include the schema image field. Serve indexable images as /next/image, not CSS.
findings.seoBoost_gap: img-alt whyItMatters only mentions 'Google Image Search'. og-tags whyItMatters only mentions Facebook/LinkedIn/Slack. video-schema mentions a carousel only. No Discover 1200px, no AI Overview thumbnail, no CSS-image warning, no Image-rich-result badge types. layout.tsx already sets max-image-preview large — scanner never checks that robots directive on customer sites.
findings.verify_how: Add checks: robots max-image-preview missing/none → warning; CSS-only hero → Images ineligible; og:image <1200px → Discover thumbnail warning. Do not change the existing large preview on SeoBoost itself.

must_implement_now: Split lib/scanner.ts img-alt into img-alt, img-alt-quality, img-dimensions, img-filename, img-caption; keep alt="" as a pass for decorative images.
Add domain check sitemap-images (image:image / image:loc) and page check for primaryImageOfPage + og:image quality (absolute HTTPS, og:image:alt, >=1200px when discoverable, not logo-only).
Upgrade video-schema to validate name, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate, and contentUrl or embedUrl; add video-captions and video-chapters (Clip/SeekToAction/<track>) when video exists.
Rewrite Next.js howToFix snippets for 16.1: fetchPriority/preload not priority; sizes on responsive/fill; remotePatterns; app/opengraph-image.tsx ImageResponse; sitemap images[] / videos[].

Ship missing SeoBoost media files: app/opengraph-image.tsx, app/twitter-image.tsx, app/icon.tsx (>=48 PNG), app/apple-icon.tsx (180), and stop pointing metadata/manifest at absent /icon.png /opengraph-image.png.
conflicts_to_avoid: Do not flag alt="" as missing — Google and WCAG 1.1.1 want empty alt on decorative images.

Do not recommend loading=lazy, preload, and fetchPriority together on the LCP image; Next 16 treats preload as mutually exclusive with loading/fetchPriority. Do not emit priority snippets (deprecated in 16).
Do not put the site logo in og:image or primaryImageOfPage; Google's 2026-03-02 image doc forbids generic logos and text-heavy cards as preferred thumbnails.
Do not revive deprecated image sitemap tags (image:caption, image:title, image:geo_location, image:license) or deprecated video sitemap tags (category, gallery_loc, player autoplay/allow_embed).
Do not fail sites with zero videos for missing VideoObject or video sitemaps. Do not treat complementary blog embeds as dedicated watch pages.
Do not tell Google Images to index CSS background-image or inlined decorative SVGs. Do not claim SVG favicons satisfy Google Search favicon (raster >=48x48 required).

Do not overwrite sibling war-room JSON. Coordinate VideoObject / ImageObject / primaryImageOfPage with the structured-data lane; LCP/CLS with the CWV lane; og:title/description with the social/meta lane.

Do not 'fix' app/layout.tsx robots.googleBot max-image-preview/max-video-preview — those are already correct. Domain mismatch seoboost.app vs boost-seo.vercel.app is out of this lane except where OG image URLs resolve.
cross_agent_notes: Siblings read: findings/02-core-web-vitals.json, findings/03-structured-data.json, findings/08-internal-linking.json. No 01/04-06/09-10 files yet.

02-CWV overlap: 02-03, 02-07, and 02-10 already flag the four Dicebear priority avatars, gated img-dimensions, and Next 16 priority deprecation. 07 owns images-category check ids (img-alt, img-dimensions, img-caption, formats, OG image quality). 02 owns CrUX/PSI LCP-INP-CLS grades and non-image CLS (fonts, ads, cookies). Do not add a second LCP numeric grade in 07. Share the img-dimensions split: one check, both lanes reference it.

02-03 must_implement_now already says remove avatar fetchPriority. 07-05 agrees — one hero change, do not fight over app/hero-animations.tsx. 07 additionally requires sizes/remotePatterns/unoptimized coaching in scanner snippets.

08-internal-linking overlap: 08-01/08-03 want one sitemap.xml parse used as crawl seed + orphan inventory. 07-02/07-08 need that same parse to also extract image:image and video:video. Build one sitemap parser; do not fetch sitemap.xml twice. Do not enqueue image/video file URLs as HTML pages (PROGRAMMATIC_PATTERNS already skips those extensions).

03-structured-data overlap: 03-04/03-08 already say VideoObject presence is not eligibility and list required name/thumbnailUrl/uploadDate. Keep one video-schema id; 07 adds field validation, Clip/SeekToAction, captions, and video sitemap. 03 owns the 2026 type map (FAQ dead, VideoObject still live). 03-09 Article.image on glossary is 03's field; 07-04 primaryImageOfPage + og:image is the Images/Discover thumbnail signal — same URL, two properties, do not emit conflicting image URLs. 03-03 host mismatch (seoboost.app vs boost-seo.vercel.app) also breaks OG image absolute URLs; 07 does not pick the canonical host.

Social / meta lane: og-tags and twitter-cards already exist (lib/scanner.ts 901-957). Extend those ids for image bytes/alt/1200px — do not add og-tags-2. 08-04 also notes glossary generateMetadata OG uses escaped ${} placeholders; 07-04 adds that glossary OG has no images array.
A11y lane: alt and captions overlap WCAG 1.1.1 / 1.2.2. Keep images-category ids for SEO coaching; a11y should reference the same checks rather than double-penalize.

Product self-audit: missing /icon.png, /opengraph-image.png, /twitter-image.png plus four priority remote avatars will fail both 02 and 07 once checks ship. Implement media files in the same PR as auditor upgrades.
